screen_model: KBM-7 near-haploid human CML cells with inducible Cas9

screen_model: K-562 human CML cells stably expressing Cas9
library_design: Custom genome-wide CRISPR-KO library with approximately 4 sgRNAs per gene and approximately 2,000 negative controls
treatment_contrast: Dose ramp ending with 48 nM GSK983 for 10 days; 14 days total; treated endpoint versus untreated endpoint

analysis_method: Median guide fold-enrichment after detection filtering; gene workbook also reports Mann-Whitney and KS statistics
quantitative_asset_locator: Source gene-ranking workbook covers 18,506 genes; no public guide-by-sample count matrix
rights_basis: ORCS structured output is MIT; no explicit open redistribution license was verified for the source workbook
validation_source_locator: Figure 1h-i: two sgRNAs per gene in K-562 competitive-growth assays, two biological replicates
notes: Phenotypes were reproduced, but target disruption was not explicitly confirmed; therefore V1, not V2.

screen_model: HCC364 human BRAF-V600E lung cancer cells expressing Cas9
